name: Contract LINE provider alignment
type: AM Platform / contracts / LINE identity configuration
scope: Require the contract LIFF and Messaging API channel to share one LINE Developers provider
Correct the Engineering production LIFF binding without changing the issued contract session
Preserve current-group read access and designated-signer-only submission

dataIsolation.guard: Provider alignment is portable, but every tenant must use its own LINE channels and uncommitted LIFF ID; display-name matching is forbidden.

definitionOfDone: The LIFF and Messaging API channel are under the same LINE Developers provider
The project-local LIFF value is deployed without committing the identifier
A known non-signer current group member reaches read-only contract access
The designated signer remains the only identity allowed to submit
No new LINE invitation or contract state change is needed
